origin: top-left corner of the 720 x 480 TS frame; x grows to the right, y grows downwards

propagation.leadingEdge: end of the emission in the propagation direction (+x), i.e. upstream of the opposed flow

flame.label: region containing both luminous sheets and the ignitor

upper.label: upper luminous band (one side of the film)

lower.label: lower luminous band (other side of the film)

gap.label: dark gap between the bands (not used for the front)

drawingNote: Drawn in the image plane of the side video, to scale in pixels. A perspective sample (parallelogram) is not used: no 3-D geometry of the B1 film is registered to this view.
